stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A shared space is not the same as a private stage.”?
options: Working with nature can sometimes protect people better than forcing nature into straight lines.
A quiet room becomes better when everyone takes care of it.
Freedom works better when it considers the people who must share the room.
Recycling works better when people know exactly where to put things and why it matters.
